# Groth Law Firm Selects Neostella for Its Next Stage of Expansion.

by

Sara Zeng

Oct 29, 2026

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/watermark-picture-city-1.webp)

## **wisconsin personal injury firm moves to neostella to connect operations, regain control of its data and build for continued expansion**.

Groth Law Firm has grown from a solo practice into a multi-office personal injury firm serving clients across Wisconsin. But as the firm expanded, the technology supporting its operations became increasingly difficult to scale with it.

Disconnected systems created workflow gaps, data constraints and costly workarounds across the business. To support its next stage of growth, Groth Law Firm has selected the enterprise case management platform from Neostella to bring its operations and information into one connected environment, while giving the firm greater control over its data and the flexibility to evolve its technology over time.

For more than 15 years, [Groth Law Firm](https://grothlawfirm.com/) has expanded its presence across Wisconsin, with locations in Brookfield, Milwaukee, Wauwatosa and Green Bay. Throughout that growth, the firm has remained focused on making legal help more accessible and less stressful for people navigating serious injuries.

As demand increased, however, the systems behind the firm were no longer keeping pace with the business.

“As our firm has grown, we’ve learned that technology has to make things easier, not create more problems. That is exactly what Neostella has done,” said Jon Groth, founder of Groth Law Firm. “Our mantra now is, ‘If it’s not in Neostella, it doesn’t exist.’ Having our information connected and under our control gives us something we can continue to build on. Ultimately, this allows us to spend more of our time doing what we’re here to do: helping people when they need us most.”

With Neostella, information that previously required separate spreadsheets or workarounds can now live within the firm’s central case management environment, creating greater consistency and visibility across its locations.

The move also gives Groth greater control over its case data, including the ability to access and move its information without depending on its platform provider to determine when or how that data can be used. Through Neostella’s open API, the firm can connect additional technologies as its business and technology needs evolve.

Neostella brings case operations, data, workflows and communications together in one platform designed for high-volume legal teams. Its flexible architecture allows firms to configure technology around the way they operate rather than restructuring their operations around their software.

“Groth’s story reflects what happens when an ambitious law firm reaches its next stage,” said Brian Mayer, VP of Product at Neostella. “The firm has expanded its reach and the number of people it can serve, and its technology now needs to support where the business is going next. Our role is to give Groth a platform it can continue to build on without losing control of how the firm operates or how its data is used.”

_This announcement was originally distributed on [Business Wire.](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261029426953/en/Groth-Law-Firm-Selects-Neostella-for-Its-Next-Stage-of-Expansion)_
